description: This file defines the ImageRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering images within the MigraDoc PDF document generation framework. It manages image formatting, loading, cropping, scaling, and error handling during rendering.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of images in PDF documents, including sizing, formatting, and error handling.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Prepares the image for rendering, calculating its file path, verifying existence, and determining dimensions.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of the image onto the PDF graphics context, handling cropping, scaling, and failure cases.

methods.name: RenderFailureImage
methods.description: Draws a placeholder or error message rectangle when the image cannot be rendered.

methods.name: CalculateImageDimensions
methods.description: Calculates the width and height of the image, including cropping and scaling, and handles errors if image loading fails.

methods.name: CreateXImage
methods.description: Creates an XImage object from a file path or base64-encoded string.
